user.description: Fill in the location to track. Username and password are optional — provide them only if you have a Flightradar24 account and want access to premium fields.

error.credentials_required: Both username and password are required.
error.login_failed: Login to Flightradar24 failed. Check your credentials.

init.description: Edit parameters for the location to track.

error.credentials_required: Both username and password are required when either is provided.
error.login_failed: Login to Flightradar24 failed. Check your credentials.

user.title: Track an airport
user.description: Enter the airport's IATA (3-letter) or ICAO (4-letter) code. Each airport gets its own device with arrivals, departures, delay statistics, weather, and aircraft counts.

error.invalid_airport_code: Airport code must be 3 (IATA) or 4 (ICAO) letters.
error.airport_already_tracked: That airport is already tracked by another subentry.

user.title: Track an aircraft
user.description: Enter the aircraft registration (tail number), e.g. G-ABCD, N12345, 4X-ISR. The aircraft is tracked persistently — even when it's on the ground, it reappears the moment it takes off.

error.invalid_registration: Registration looks invalid — it should be at least 3 characters.
error.aircraft_already_tracked: That aircraft is already tracked by another subentry.
error.aircraft_not_found: Aircraft not found. Flightradar24 doesn't recognize this tail number — check spelling and try again.
error.aircraft_check_failed: Couldn't reach Flightradar24 to verify. Check your connection and try again.

flight_not_found.message: No flight found matching {number}. Check the flight number, callsign, or aircraft registration and try again.

aircraft_not_found.message: Aircraft {registration} is not known to Flightradar24. Check the tail number and try again.

aircraft_check_failed.message: Couldn't verify {registration} with Flightradar24 — check your connection and try again.
